text: Model and Effort are dropdowns in the cluster form, fed by /meta (models: claude-opus-5-5 default, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-fable-5-1; efforts low..max).
Every other form field shows its default when not provided, like Max attempts; cpu 500m/4 and memory 1Gi/8Gi are real defaults applied to agent pods.
The ribbon context gauge's auto-compact tick sits on the ring.
